note: Subclasses (roadmap item 60, first part; core/game/game_subclass.gd). A subclass is a calling layered on an heir's class: none or one, taken by anyone, whatever their class, and it adds small bonuses to what the class already does and never replaces its skills. A subclass is picked when the dynasty is founded, taken later by the living heir for gold, or passed to a child (born to it). One chosen at the founding or inherited is 'founded': its perks are stronger by `founder_scale`; one taken later gives them at their plain strength. A perk is a multiplier on a number the rules already have (1.4 is 40% more, 0.85 is 15% less); the founded strength is 1 + (m - 1) x founder_scale.

perks.find_mult: the chance of finding eggs and young
perks.keep_mult: the yearly cost of keeping creatures
perks.fertility_mult: how often a breeding pair has young
perks.mutation_mult: how often young are born with a new trait

subclasses.name: Breeder
subclasses.about: Raises creatures for a living: finds young more often, keeps them cheaper, breeds them better and sells them dearer.

text.taken: {h} takes up the calling of a {name} for {gold} gold.
text.changed: {h} gives up the calling of a {old} to become a {name}, for {gold} gold.
text.inherited: {h} is born to the calling of a {name}, as {parent} was.
text.outside_life: Only a living heir can take a subclass.
